references.text: Ziph is mentioned as a place where David hid from Saul. The inhabitants of Ziph betrayed David to King Saul.
The wilderness of Ziph is again mentioned as a place where David hid, and the Ziphites informed Saul about David's hiding place.
Psalm 54 has a heading that refers to the Ziphites who told Saul where David was.
Ziph is also mentioned in the list of cities in the hill country of Judah, showing that there were two places with this name.
